name: @uniterra-solutions/uniterra-updater
description: Uniterra update logic: probes the npm CLI dist-tag and the uniterra GitHub release, decides whether an update is available, maps the update-prompt response onto the action to take (quit-and-update / skip-version), and supports the user's skipped-version gate. Pure (no Electron imports) so the decision semantics are unit-testable.

scripts.test: pnpm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test "test/**/*.test.mts"
